**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Include projection ownership in the graph-edge unique key**

When two source events project the same source/target/kind tuple, `upsertGraphEdges` now gives them distinct owner-derived `_id` values, but this unique index still prohibits the second row. MongoDB therefore raises a duplicate-key error instead of retaining both owners; because ingestion replaces the base events and deletes their old projections before the bulk insert, this can also leave the batch partially applied. Include the source-event owner in the unique key or remove/migrate this obsolete endpoint-only uniqueness constraint.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep derived graph identity fields authoritative**

For an ordinary event whose `extra` contains fields such as `node_id`, `node_kind`, `preview`, or `source_event_id`, this spread overwrites the identity and content computed for the derived graph node. The derived row can consequently describe a different node or owner than the embedding and projections created from the event ID, contradicting the auto-materialization contract immediately below. Preserve arbitrary metadata first, then assign the reserved derived fields after it.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Merge retention labels for shared sentence nodes**

When two `graph.node` events in the same project contain the same sentence, they generate the same sentence event ID, and this early return keeps only the first event's retention labels and provenance. If the first source is unlabeled and the second is retention-exempt, the shared derived sentence still receives `expiresAt` and can disappear while the labeled source's edge continues to reference it; reversing batch order produces different persistence. Merge the owners' labels/provenance or make the derived identity source-specific instead of silently discarding later owners.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Retry search-index setup after transient failures**

If Atlas search-index creation or readiness polling fails transiently, this catch records `searchIndexStatus: "error"` but returns normally, so `materializeVectorPartition` resolves and `ensureVectorPartition` caches that resolved promise for the connection's lifetime. Later writes never call `ensurePartitionVectorSearchIndex` again, leaving all queries on the bounded newest-row cosine fallback until restart and potentially missing older relevant vectors. Evict/error the cached setup or explicitly retry partitions whose search status is not ready.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Resolve symlinks before approving hydration paths**

When a path lexically inside `OPENPLANNER_SOURCE_ROOT` traverses a symlink whose target is outside that root, this prefix check accepts it and the later `readFile` follows the link. An indexed row can therefore hydrate arbitrary files outside the configured containment boundary whenever the source tree contains an attacker-controlled or imported symlink. Compare real paths or open without following symlinks before reading the source.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Remove obsolete derived data when source text is cleared**

When an ordinary event ID previously had text and is replayed with empty text or as a non-indexable event, this branch is skipped but its existing `graph.node:derive:<id>` event and graph-node embedding are never removed. The old preview and vector can therefore remain indefinitely—especially when the previous row was retention-exempt—even though the authoritative source no longer contains that content. Reconcile source-owned derived rows and embeddings on every replacement, including replacements that produce no new node.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Validate embedding batch size before entering the loop**

If a caller supplies `config.embeddingBatchSize: 0`, this loop never advances `offset`, repeatedly sends an empty batch, and never returns; negative or fractional values also produce invalid slicing behavior. Since `BatchIndexConfig` exposes an unconstrained number, normalize it to a positive integer or reject invalid configuration before beginning any provider work.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Continue draining the embedding flush queue**

When more than one flush is queued behind saturated batch slots, completion of the active flush starts only the first queued callback, and that callback's `finally` merely decrements the counter without shifting the next entry. Large or sustained embedding bursts can consequently retain unresolved flush promises and closures in `batchQueue` indefinitely, causing an unbounded memory leak even when the main flushing loop has already served their waiters. Use a common completion path that keeps draining while capacity and queued work remain.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Close the internally opened hydration LMDB handle**

When `OPENPLANNER_HYDRATION_LMDB_PATH` is configured and hydration initializes, this function opens an LMDB database but retains only the cache adapter, with no close path from `getHydrationCache` or `OpenPlannerSdk.close()`. Repeated SDK lifecycles and graceful shutdowns can therefore leak file descriptors/background resources and leave the cache database locked or incompletely flushed. Retain ownership of the handle and expose or invoke an idempotent close operation.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

+(ns openplanner.graph.recall.mongo
+  "Trusted SDK/Mongo boundary. Request JSON has no authority port or scope.
+   LGPL-3.0-or-later."
+  (:require [goog.crypt :as crypt]
+            [goog.crypt.Sha256]
+            [openplanner.graph.recall.contract :as recall-contract]
+            [openplanner.graph.recall.core :as recall]
+            [openplanner.graph.recall.mongo-contract :as contract]
+            [openplanner.graph.recall.ranking :as ranking]))
+
+(defn- fail! [code]
+  (throw (ex-info "Scoped graph recall boundary failed" {:recall-code code})))
+
+(defn- unique? [values] (= (count values) (count (set values))))
+
+(defn- digest [value]
+  (let [hash (goog.crypt.Sha256.)]
+    (.update hash (crypt/stringToUtf8ByteArray (pr-str (ranking/canonical-data value))))
+    (crypt/byteArrayToHex (.digest hash))))
+
+(defn- ^:async current-authority! [resolve-current-authority]
+  (let [authority (try (js->clj (await (resolve-current-authority)) :keywordize-keys true)
+                       (catch :default _error (fail! :authority-unavailable)))]
+    (when (some? authority)
+      (when-not (and (contract/valid-authority? authority)
+                     (unique? (map :id (:records authority)))) (fail! :invalid-authority)))
+    authority))
+
+(defn- authority-binding [authority]
+  (when authority
+    [(:scope authority) (:project authority) (vec (sort-by :id (:records authority)))]))
+
+(defn- ^:async assert-current! [resolve-current-authority authority]
+  ;; Provider and database awaits cannot preserve a grant. Refuse the whole
+  ;; snapshot if any current principal, policy, admitted record or text changed.
+  (when-not (= (authority-binding authority)
+               (authority-binding (await (current-authority! resolve-current-authority))))
+    (fail! :authority-changed)))
+
+(defn- native-path [object keys]
+  (reduce (fn [value key] (when (some? value) (aget value key))) object keys))
+
+(defn- keyword-value [value] (if (string? value) (keyword value) value))
+
+(defn- decode-selection [selection]
+  (if-not (map? selection) selection
+    (cond-> (update selection :status keyword-value)
+      (map? (:feedback selection)) (update-in [:feedback :status] keyword-value)
+      (map? (:failure selection)) (update :failure #(-> % (update :stage keyword-value) (update :code keyword-value)))
+      (vector? (:hits selection)) (update :hits #(mapv (fn [hit] (if (map? hit) (update hit :reason keyword-value) hit)) %)))))
+
+(defn valid-scoped-result-js?
+  "Check the owning result contract at a consuming wire boundary; grants no authority."
+  [raw-result]
+  (let [result (js->clj raw-result :keywordize-keys true)
+        result (if (map? result)
+                 (-> result (update :field-status keyword-value) (update :selection decode-selection)) result)]
+    (boolean (contract/valid-result? result))))
+
+(defn- supported? [sdk]
+  (every? #(fn? (native-path sdk %))
+          [["mongo" "graphNodeEmbeddings" "find"] ["mongo" "graphEdges" "find"]
+           ["embeddingRuntime" "hot" "getModel"]
+           ["embeddingRuntime" "hot" "getEmbeddingFunctionForModel"]]))
+
+(defn- ^:async rows! [^js collection filter maximum]
+  (let [^js cursor (.find collection (clj->js filter))
+        _ (.sort cursor #js {:_id 1})
+        _ (.limit cursor (inc maximum))
+        _ (.maxTimeMS cursor 5000)
+        rows (js->clj (await (.toArray cursor)) :keywordize-keys true)]
+    (when-not (vector? rows) (fail! :invalid-projection))
+    (when (> (count rows) maximum) (fail! :storage-limit-exceeded))
+    rows))
+
+(defn- text-sha256 [text]
+  (let [hash (goog.crypt.Sha256.)]
+    (.update hash (crypt/stringToUtf8ByteArray text))
+    (crypt/byteArrayToHex (.digest hash))))
+
+(defn- decode-indices [authority model rows]
+  (let [ids (set (map :id (:records authority)))
+        texts (into {} (map (juxt :id :text) (:records authority)))
+        ;; Exclude foreign/legacy compact rows before inspecting their content.
+        bound (filterv #(and (ids (:source_event_id %)) (= (:node_id %) (:source_event_id %))
+                              (= (:project authority) (:project %)) (= model (:embedding_model %))
+                              (= (:source_text_hash_sha256 %) (text-sha256 (get texts (:source_event_id %))))) rows)
+        decoded (mapv #(hash-map :id (:_id %) :event-id (:source_event_id %) :model (:embedding_model %)
+                                 :dimensions (:embedding_dimensions %) :chunk (:chunk_index %)
+                                 :embedding (:embedding %)) bound)]
+    (when-not (and (every? contract/valid-index? decoded) (unique? (map :id decoded))
+                   (unique? (map (juxt :event-id :model :chunk) decoded))
+                   (every? #(= (:dimensions %) (count (:embedding %))) decoded))
+      (fail! :invalid-embedding))
+    (vec (sort-by :id decoded))))
+
+(defn- decode-edges [authority rows]
+  (let [ids (set (map :id (:records authority))) scope (:scope authority)
+        admitted (filterv (fn [row]
+                            (let [data (get-in row [:data :scoped_recall]) evidence (:provenance_event_ids data)]
+                              (and (= (:project authority) (:project row))
+                                   (= 1 (:version data)) (= (:org-id scope) (:org_id data))
+                                   (= (:project authority) (:project data))
+                                   (= (:actor-id scope) (:character_id data))
+                                   (ids (:source_node_id row)) (ids (:target_node_id row))
+                                   (vector? evidence) (seq evidence) (every? ids evidence)))) rows)
+        edges (mapv (fn [row]
+                      (let [data (get-in row [:data :scoped_recall])]
+                        (when-not (contract/valid-projection? data) (fail! :invalid-projection))
+                        {:id (:_id row) :source (:source_node_id row) :target (:target_node_id row)
+                         :cost (:cost data) :provenance-node-ids (:provenance_event_ids data)})) admitted)]
+    (vec (sort-by :id edges))))
+
+(defn- snapshot [authority nodes indices edges]
+  {:version 1 :scope (:scope authority) :index-status :ready
+   :revision (str "scoped-snapshot:" (digest [(:scope authority) (:project authority)
+                                             (sort-by :id (:records authority)) indices edges]))
+   ;; This read profile does not load or integrate a physical field. The
+   ;; explicit outer state keeps these sentinels from masquerading as its proof.
+   :field-revision "not-loaded" :field-owner "not-loaded"
+   :nodes nodes :edges edges :influences []})
+
+(defn- select [authority snapshot request]
+  (recall/recall-plan snapshot
+                      (mapv #(hash-map :node-id (:id %) :event-id (:id %)
+                                      :policy-revision (get-in authority [:scope :policy-revision])
+                                      :allowed? true) (:records authority)) request))
+
+(defn- ^:async query-embedding! [sdk model query format-query-text]
+  (let [^js hot (native-path sdk ["embeddingRuntime" "hot"])
+        ^js provider (.getEmbeddingFunctionForModel hot model)]
+    (when-not (fn? (native-path provider ["generate"])) (fail! :unsupported-capability))
+    (let [text (try (format-query-text query)
+                    (catch :default _error (fail! :embedding-unavailable)))
+          _ (when-not (and (string? text) (seq (.trim text))) (fail! :invalid-embedding))
+          values (try (js->clj (await (.generate provider (clj->js [text]))))
+                      (catch :default _error (fail! :embedding-unavailable)))]
+      (when-not (and (vector? values) (= 1 (count values)) (contract/valid-embedding? (first values)))
+        (fail! :invalid-embedding))
+      (first values))))
+
+(defn- ^:async stored-selection! [sdk resolve-current-authority authority request format-query-text]
+  (let [ids (mapv :id (:records authority))
+        scope (:scope authority)
+        ^js hot (native-path sdk ["embeddingRuntime" "hot"])
+        model (.getModel hot
+                         (clj->js {:source "graph-event" :kind "graph.node" :project (:project authority)}))]
+    (when-not (contract/valid-identity? model) (fail! :invalid-embedding))
+    (if (empty? ids)
+      (do (await (assert-current! resolve-current-authority authority))
+          (select authority (snapshot authority [] [] []) request))
+      (let [indices (decode-indices authority model
+                                   (await (rows! (native-path sdk ["mongo" "graphNodeEmbeddings"])
+                                                 {:project (:project authority) :source_event_id {:$in ids}
+                                                  :node_id {:$in ids} :embedding_model model
+                                                  :$expr {:$eq ["$node_id" "$source_event_id"]}} 1536)))]

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Exclude obsolete embedding dimensions from scoped recall**

When a provider changes vector dimensions without changing its model name, old and newly reindexed rows coexist because dimensions are part of the embedding row identity, while this query retrieves every dimension for the model. After the query provider returns the current-size vector, `rank-nodes` attempts cosine similarity against the old-size rows and fails the entire recall with `invalid-embedding`; the stale rows can therefore keep otherwise complete recall broken until manually deleted. Select rows matching the generated query dimension or reconcile obsolete dimensions during reindexing.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

+(deftype LayeredCache [layers]

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve remaining TTL during layered cache promotion**

When a lower-layer entry is close to expiration, promotion writes only its value into prior layers with default options, assigning each promoted copy a fresh full default TTL. A one-second warm entry read just before expiry can consequently remain stale in the hot layer for hours, violating the original expiration and allowing outdated projections to outlive their source cache entry. Promote the entry's remaining expiration metadata rather than resetting its lifetime.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Close the Mongo client when initialization fails**

After `client.connect()` succeeds, any later index creation, migration, or TTL reconciliation error rejects `openMongoDB` without closing the newly created client. Startup retries can therefore accumulate live connection pools and failed one-shot processes can remain open even though no `MongoConnection` was returned for the caller to close. Wrap post-connect initialization in a failure path that closes the client before rethrowing.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
